digest.component_or_area: DC outbound differ and text truncation
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for comment and description truncation that Cloud possesses, creating risk of silent re-emission of truncated values across reconciliation passes

DC's comment sanitizer reuses the description fit function (fit_outbound), binding both to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767), which is correct per jira.text.field.character.limit but lacks documented provenance
The 32767 character ceiling for DC comments and descriptions is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit covering both field types as of Jira 7.0 (JRASERVER-28519), not an assumption

Tests injecting only outbound_mapper without inbound_mapper and links still trigger config fallback to Cloud via the OR-guarded select_backend(), causing DC convergence tests to silently validate Cloud behavior instead

DC comment convergence testing through compute_outbound_mutations silently resolves Cloud's sanitizer via _resolve_sanitizer(None) independently of any injected mapper, making value-based convergence assertions vacuous
